name: ProofSight Buyer
description: ProofSight Buyer is the demo client agent in the ProofSight agent-commerce demo. It discovers ProofSight through the Concordium Agent Registry (CIS-8004), verifies ProofSight's Verified by Concordium badge before trusting it, pays per analysis request with x402 micropayments in CCD on Concordium, and receives a report whose hash ProofSight anchors on-chain as an audit record. The buyer is itself a registered, verified agent, so the demo shows verified agent-to-agent commerce in both directions.

skills.name: Verified Agent Purchase
skills.description: Verifies a seller agent's Concordium badge via the Agent Registry, then buys a service over x402 with a CCD micropayment and checks the on-chain audit anchor of the delivered result.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge: on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
